input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: hanger-codesign milestone 4a: the top-tier Cusick solver, uncalibrated, against nine measured drape coefficients (Petrak et al. 2021)
errors: Importing run.py from a -c one-liner made 3c's `import run as m3` pick up the new run.py itself; run as a script it works, and the test pins 3a's module as test_m3e does.
First full test-suite run errored on the same `run` collision; fixed in tests/test_m4a.py.
integrity_issues: K1 to K3 were registered mid-run after three of nine KES-bending results; they are labelled not blind, scored apart, and all three were refuted.
V1 to V2 test a factor fitted in-sample to the same nine fabrics; reported as a calibration, not a prediction.

Source inconsistencies recorded, not corrected: Petrak et al. Table 5 KES r values are not reproduced by their Table 6, and two KES weft bending values (F6, F7) look like a decimal slip; used as printed.

doc_friction.issue: Milestone 4 was listed as 'blocked on egress' for three sessions; this session Europe PMC's REST API (fullTextXML) served CC BY papers with the needed table. Worth adding to cloud-session.md's 'Outbound hosts' as a known-good route for open-access paper tables.

The `run` module-name collision among hanger-codesign experiment scripts (3a's run.py is imported as `run` by later milestones) bites every new milestone's tests; a shared loader helper in the project would remove the copy-pasted sys.modules pinning.

deviations.why: Pre-registration expects predictions before data; I added K1-K3 mid-run after seeing 3 of 9 KES results and V1-V2 after the main report.
deviations.did: Registered them in run.py and LOG.md with exactly what had been seen, committed and pushed before their solves, scored apart from M1-M7.
deviations.result: K1-K3 all refuted (the three seen were unrepresentative); V1-V2 held (in-sample). Labelled accordingly.

goal: Advance the hanger-codesign programme with its first comparison against measured fabric drape (milestone 4, blocked since milestone 2).
notes: Registered M1-M7: M1-M3 held (all converged; Spearman 0.967, Pearson 0.965, above every Optitex column 0.853-0.942), M4 acceptance refuted (RMSE 0.148 vs 0.08), M5 refuted (bias +0.143), M6 refuted (3.75->2.5 mm raises DC ~0.03 on 6 of 9), M7 refuted narrowly. K1-K3 refuted (KES RMSE 0.152, r 0.651). Post hoc: one factor 0.485 on FAST bending, LOO RMSE 0.050; V1-V2 held (solved RMSE 0.036, 8 of 9 within 0.03 of interpolation). 72 chains, ~8 core-hours on 4 cores. Local checks: tests 66 passed (hanger-codesign), research build ok, research_live_links ok, check_md_links ok, cite_check 5/5 ok, post front matter/links/similarity ok.
